newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 8.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:
- Newt Gingrich narrowly won re-election as House Speaker despite defections by nine Republicans troubled by his ethics violations.
- A special White House panel concluded it could find no evidence that exposure to chemical weapons had hurt the health of Gulf war veterans, but it said further study was needed.
- Malaria -- killing between one and three million people in 1996 -- is becoming resistant to medication.
- New York City's public hospital agency has won a contract agreement with one of its teaching affiliates that for the first time ties pay to productivity.
- Three competing teams of balloonists have begun or are about to begin nonstop voyages around the world.
